diagnostic_change_only: Run the exact worker through separately hash-bound stdlib bootstrap with faulthandler enabled, line-buffered diagnostics and capped selected module/setup/resource phase markers. Preserve exact worker/model/YAML/native resources() and values. No exception suppression, model patch, precision/RNG/profiler changes, training replay, or changes to historical guards.
discriminating_observation: The last completed import/setup/resource marker and fatal stack identify an observed crash phase if SIGSEGV repeats; if not reproduced record not-reproduced. No assumption that previous failure was import/CUDA/fvcore or model bug.

outcome_interpretation.sigsegv: preserve exact returncode, marker/stack/stdout/stderr and process identity, classify implementation/inconclusive; no further run this stage
outcome_interpretation.success: diagnostic process succeeded but tracing means no latency/efficiency/technical admission claim; original missing uninstrumented paired resources and equivalence remain
outcome_interpretation.unknown: reconcile exact request; never replay or signal
